title: N.C.R.B. (M.H.A.) CRIME IN INDIA - 1995 2.3.3 For the purpose of crime analysis in Urban areas, the present effort has been one to analyse the various crimes reported in the 23 mega cities and bring forth the main pattern of crime scene, type of offenders, result of enforcement etc. The analysis would cover the crime patterns and emerging trends.
